description: Built 31-10-2026 from VATSIM Spain's LEMD Pilot Briefing (v1.0, May 2022), section 1.7 'Preference Configuration' -- the only publicly-confirmed source found (the AENA/ENAIRE-equivalent login-gated 'AD Manual Operativo' was not accessible; see docs/LEMD_RUNWAY_RESEARCH.md). Four modes, matching the briefing's day/night x preferred/no-preference structure. Runway-coded ids (e.g. 32R32LA36R36LD = arrivals 32R+32L, departures 36R+36L). maxCrosswindKt left at the pack default: the briefing's only limit is a single COMBINED 10kt-tailwind-AND-20kt-crosswind figure (incl. gusts), which this schema cannot express jointly -- see settings.json and the research doc. No per-mode capacity found. RWY 36L/14R is restricted in reality to longer-runway-need/medevac/state aircraft on a non-RNAV SID -- no schema field for this, recorded here only, not enforced.

modes.description: Day (0700-2300 local) PREFERRED configuration (VATSIM Spain LEMD Pilot Briefing section 1.7): arrivals 32R and 32L, departures 36R and 36L.

Day (0700-2300 local) NO-PREFERENCE fallback (VATSIM Spain LEMD Pilot Briefing section 1.7): arrivals 18R and 18L, departures 14R and 14L. The briefing names this as the fallback used when the preferred configuration's combined 10 kt tailwind / 20 kt crosswind limit cannot be maintained; it does not say what happens if conditions exceed this fallback's own limits too -- a genuine gap, not modelled with an invented further fallback (see docs/LEMD_RUNWAY_RESEARCH.md).

Night (2300-0700 local) PREFERRED configuration (VATSIM Spain LEMD Pilot Briefing section 1.7): arrivals 32R, departures 36L. The briefing restricts RWY 36L use at night to aircraft needing a longer runway than 36R, plus medevac/rescue/state flights, departing via a conventional (non-RNAV) SID -- not enforceable in this schema, recorded here only.
Night (2300-0700 local) NO-PREFERENCE fallback (VATSIM Spain LEMD Pilot Briefing section 1.7): arrivals 32R and 32L, departures 36R.
